## Runs 6–7 — field traces before the Landau fan

Plan step 3: finish the handoff's pending spot-check analysis. Raw voltage, drain current and leakage are plotted first, followed by signed Vxx/I and window-tested FFTs. Data/6 is complete (921 points, 120.36 min); data/7 is complete (486 points, 95.68 min). Neither rails: |Vxx/I| reaches 530 and 587 ohm, while drain current stays 9.84–9.94 and 9.81–9.93 nA respectively. Sample T spans 1.165–1.292 K. Negative electron-trace minima are retained, not rectified before the FFT.

**Read:** run 6 has a low-frequency family near 7.2 T and multiples near 14.4, 22.1 and 29.5 T. The last may be a distinct branch or a fourth harmonic; one density cannot decide. Run 7 has overlapping low-frequency weight near 5–7 T and a 12.3 T feature. The onset helper reports the low-frequency component persisting to the chosen 0.7 T analysis edge (censored, not a measured onset). This advances to a density-resolved fan; it does not justify assigning a stacking order. In particular, the quantitative model masses/frequencies quoted in measure cells 39/41 are not independently established by the supplied cards and are not treated as classification evidence.

Calibration caveats: run 5 measures a gate-capacitance ratio, not an absolute lever arm. Its resistance-minimum-based D offset is a working symmetry estimate, not proof of zero internal displacement field. The two CNP ridges belong to the same measured B_1–B_2 voltage pair; a spatial two-region interpretation remains a hypothesis. Density evolution and possible parallel fan origins must be checked before assigning separate band or spatial branches.

from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, summarize_run, sdh_fft, sdh_onset
root = Path.cwd()
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(12, 9), sharex='col')
traces=[]
report=[]
for col, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    r=open_run(root/'data'/str(rid)); print(summarize_run(r))
    ch={c.cid:c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    b=r.col('magnet_field'); current=r.col('sr0_X')/ch['sr0'].gain
    resistance=r.col('sr1_X')/ch['sr1'].gain/current
    axes[0,col].plot(b, r.col('sr1_X')*1e6); axes[0,col].set_ylabel('Raw sr1 X (uV)')
    axes[1,col].plot(b, current*1e9); axes[1,col].set_ylabel('Drain I (nA)')
    for g in ('k_2400_tg_curr','k_2400_bg_curr'): axes[2,col].plot(b,r.col(g)*1e12,label=g)
    axes[2,col].legend(fontsize=7); axes[2,col].set_ylabel('Gate I (pA)'); axes[2,col].set_xlabel('B (T)')
    axes[0,col].set_title(f'Raw run {rid}')
    order=np.argsort(b); b=b[order]; resistance=resistance[order]
    traces.append((rid,b,resistance))
    dt=np.diff(r.col('time')); db=np.abs(np.diff(r.col('magnet_field')))
    print('run',rid,'wall min',(r.meta['end_time']-r.meta['start_time'])/60,'median dt',np.median(dt),'median overhead beyond 0.137T/min',np.median(dt-db*438))
    print('R signed range',resistance.min(),resistance.max(),'I nA',current.min()*1e9,current.max()*1e9,'T',r.col('T_sample').min(),r.col('T_sample').max())
    print('phase sr1 quantiles',np.quantile(r.col('sr1_P'),[0,.1,.5,.9,1]))
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(root/'hera_scratch/spots_raw.png',dpi=130); plt.show()
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,2,figsize=(12,7))
for col,(rid,b,resistance) in enumerate(traces):
    axes[0,col].plot(b,resistance); axes[0,col].set_xlabel('B (T)'); axes[0,col].set_ylabel('Signed Vxx/I (Ohm)'); axes[0,col].set_title(f'Run {rid}')
    for blo in (1.0,1.5,2.0):
        f,a=sdh_fft(resistance[:,None],b,b_range=(blo,10),log=False,nfft=4096,bg_degree=3)
        a=a[0]; axes[1,col].plot(f,a/a.max(),label=f'{blo}-10 T')
        pk,_=find_peaks(a); pk=sorted((p for p in pk if 3<f[p]<65),key=lambda p:-a[p])[:5]
        print('run',rid,'window',blo,'peaks',[(round(f[p],2),round(a[p]/a.max(),2)) for p in pk])
    axes[1,col].set_xlim(0,65); axes[1,col].legend(); axes[1,col].set_xlabel('F (T)'); axes[1,col].set_ylabel('Normalized FFT, linear signed R')
    try:
        onset=sdh_onset(resistance,b,b_lo=0.7,r_full_scale=5000,bg_degree=3)
        print('run',rid,onset.summary())
    except ValueError as exc: print('onset unresolved',rid,str(exc))
fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig(root/'hera_scratch/spots_analysis.png',dpi=130); plt.show()
r=open_run(root/'data/5'); dt=np.diff(r.col('time')); within=np.arange(len(dt))%66!=65
print('run5 point dt quantiles',np.quantile(dt[within],[.1,.5,.9]),'turnaround',np.median(dt[~within]),'wall min',(r.meta['end_time']-r.meta['start_time'])/60)

## HERA — Landau fan across both carrier signs at working D≈0

> **05:23** · Landau fan B\_1-B\_2: B 0 to 10 T, 95 rows; D approx 0, n -1.2 to +3.2e12 cm^-2,111 points; Si 0; base T; 3 s dwell · **ETA ~17:23** (≈12h)

**Plan step 4** (`hera_scratch/plan.md`): data/6–7 show resolvable oscillations without clipping, so follow their density evolution on the only wired voltage pair, **B_1–B_2**. In data/6 the 29.5 T peak is near 4×7.2 T; a fan can distinguish a harmonic from an independent branch by its trajectory, crossings and common versus displaced CNP origin. No stacking label follows from tone count alone. Gate B is verified against measure cell 18 and the card; handoff cells 44/46 establish zero field/gates and the bound kernel. The cell rechecks validators and live state before any write.

Co-sweep TG/BG along the run-5 working D=0 line, **n_A −1.2…+3.2×10¹² cm⁻² in 0.04×10¹² steps**, Si=0, base T, 111 points/row. The absolute density scale remains geometry-anchored and the D offset is a symmetry estimate; save the actual gate and field readbacks so these can be revised. The window includes both CNP ridges and both available carrier signs, with small margins to TG limits; larger hole densities cannot be reached on this line inside the committed box. It does not survey other D, negative B, or Si. Those additions would require additional maps/ramp time and are deferred until this fan provides evidence.

**Field grid and resolution:** start where the magnet sits: 0, 0.7, 1, 1.25 T controls; 61 inverse-B-spaced rows from 1.5 to 4 T; 4.2…10 T in 0.2 T steps. Total 95×111=10,545 points. Low-B controls are sparse and cannot establish the oscillation onset or resolve the fast branch below 1.5 T. Above 1.5 T, Δ(1/B)=0.006944 T⁻¹ samples the observed 30 T feature at 4.8 points/period (3.8 at 38 T); the density spacing samples a fourfold LL period at 1.5 T at 3.6 points. Higher harmonics and symmetry-broken fine structure may require later refinement. At high B, finer 0.2 T spacing preserves crossings. Fixed 3 s dwell is 10τ at the operator's 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct; sr1 100 μV provides 10 kΩ nominal headroom, sr0 20 mV. All followed channels have live plots.

**Price and endpoint:** fixed magnet rate 1 A/min and 7.3 A/T give 10×7.3=73 min ramp floor; measured runs 6/7 add about 3.08 s per field set. Data/5 measured 1.098 s per gate point at 1 s dwell/NPLC1 and 5.77 s turnaround. Budget 3.3 s/point here for dual gates and added readbacks (9.67 h), plus ramp, flyback/row settles (~15 min) and contingency: **12 h**. Reprice from the first rows. Ends at **10 T, n=+3.2**, ready for a downward-field follow-up if warranted.

**Checkpoints:** inspect the first few points and first zero-field row for live current, leakage, rail/headroom and CNP consistency with data/5; inspect the 0.7/1 T rows, then at least every 30 min with scientific reviews near 2, 4 and 6 T. `hera-watch` is armed before execution. Per-point guards stop for |gate I|>1 nA, either lock-in above 90% full scale, drain current <5 nA, base-T or measured-field/gate mismatch; thermometry freshness is checked every ten points. If there is no coherent fan by 4 T despite healthy channels, review partial raw maps before spending the upper-field budget. Safety stop returns E0 and requires explicit re-grant. **CAEN caveat:** kernel interrupt does not stop a commanded magnet ramp; the supply continues to its last target. A ramp emergency needs the operator at the instrument. Actual state must be reread after any abort; no automatic zero-field return is hidden in this cell.

# Plan step 4: fixed-D Landau fan, B_1-B_2, starting from handoff zero field.
import numpy as np
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# Read-only preconditions before any instrument writes.
for label, parameter, limits in (
    ('TG', k_tg.volt, (-0.3, 1.0)), ('BG', k_bg.volt, (-1.3, 2.0)),
    ('Si', dc205.smart_voltage, (-25.0, 25.0)), ('Si raw', dc205.voltage, (-25.0, 25.0)),
    ('B', magnet.field, (-10.0, 10.0)),
    ('T sample', heater.sample_setpoint, (0.0, 100.0)),
    ('T vaporizer', heater.vaporizer_setpoint, (0.0, 100.0))):
    actual = (float(parameter.vals._min_value), float(parameter.vals._max_value))
    print(f'{label} validator: expected {limits}, actual {actual}')
    assert actual == limits, f'{label} validator mismatch'
assert B_SESSION_CAP == 10.0 and T_SESSION_CAP == 100.0
for name in ('T_sample', 'T_vaporizer'):
    assert_thermometry_live(name, VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[name], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_fan_Ts, _fan_Tv = T_sample(), T_vaporizer()
_fan_B0, _fan_Si = magnet.field(), k_si()
_fan_ps, _fan_output = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
_fan_ranges = (heater.sample_range(), heater.vaporizer_range())
print(f'Expected base Ts 1.0..1.5 K, Tv<1.6 K within 0.6 K of sample, heaters 0/0; actual {_fan_Ts}, {_fan_Tv}, {_fan_ranges}')
print(f'Expected |B|<0.02 T, Si=0 V, PS/output on; actual {_fan_B0:+.5f}, {_fan_Si:+.4f}, {_fan_ps}/{_fan_output}')
print(f'Start gates TG/BG (will be set): {k_tg.volt():+.5f}/{k_bg.volt():+.5f} V')
assert 1.0 <= _fan_Ts <= 1.5 and _fan_Tv < 1.6 and abs(_fan_Tv-_fan_Ts)<0.6
assert _fan_ranges == (0, 0) and abs(_fan_B0)<0.02 and abs(_fan_Si)<0.01
assert _fan_ps and _fan_output
assert dc205.voltage_range()==2 and dc205.output()==1 and dc205.ramp_rate==0.5
assert k_si is dc205.smart_voltage and k_tg is k_2400_tg and k_bg is k_2400_bg
_fan_wiring = {'source':'T_0','drain':'B_3','sr1+':'B_1','sr1-':'B_2',
               'sr2+':'n.c.','sr2-':'n.c.','sr3+':'n.c.','sr3-':'n.c.'}
print(f'Expected hardwired contact map {_fan_wiring}; actual {WIRING}')
assert WIRING == _fan_wiring
_fan_drive, _fan_freq = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency()
_fan_taus = (sr0.time_constant(), sr1.time_constant())
_fan_slopes = (sr0.filter_slope(), sr1.filter_slope())
_fan_nplc = (k_tg.nplci(), k_bg.nplci())
print(f'Expected drive 1 V/13.777 Hz, tau .3/.3 s, slope 24/24, NPLC 1/1; actual {_fan_drive}/{_fan_freq}, {_fan_taus}, {_fan_slopes}, {_fan_nplc}')
print(f'Gate pacing TG/BG: steps {k_tg.volt.step}/{k_bg.volt.step}, inter_delay {k_tg.volt.inter_delay}/{k_bg.volt.inter_delay}; unchanged')
assert abs(_fan_drive-1.0)<1e-6 and abs(_fan_freq-13.777)<0.01
assert _fan_taus == (0.3,0.3) and _fan_slopes == (24,24) and _fan_nplc == (1,1)
assert k_tg.volt.step==0.005 and k_bg.volt.step==0.005
assert meas_config['sr0_gain']==-1e6 and meas_config.get('sr1_gain',1)==1
assert meas_config['bias_resistor']==100e6 and meas_config['bias_channel']=='sr1'

FAN_CAL = dict(c_tg=0.0027960593093052633,c_bg=0.002160696465377614,
               n_offset=-0.08937933224099137,D_offset=-0.013)
fan_n = np.linspace(-1.2, 3.2, 111)  # units 1e12 cm^-2, absolute scale provisional
fan_tg, fan_bg = calc_gate_voltages(fan_n, np.zeros_like(fan_n), **FAN_CAL)
fan_B = np.concatenate(([0.0,0.7,1.0,1.25], field_invB(1.5,4.0,61), np.linspace(4.2,10.0,30)))
assert len(fan_B)==95 and np.all(np.diff(fan_B)>0)
assert np.all((-0.3<=fan_tg)&(fan_tg<=1.0)) and np.all((-1.3<=fan_bg)&(fan_bg<=2.0))
assert np.all((0<=fan_B)&(fan_B<=10.0))
_check_n,_check_D = calc_nD(fan_tg,fan_bg,**FAN_CAL)
assert np.allclose(_check_n,fan_n) and np.max(np.abs(_check_D))<1e-10
print(f'Fan {len(fan_B)} x {len(fan_n)} points; TG {fan_tg[0]:+.6f}..{fan_tg[-1]:+.6f} V, BG {fan_bg[0]:+.6f}..{fan_bg[-1]:+.6f} V')
print('Ramp budget: 10 T * 7.3 A/T / (1 A/min) = 73 min; total estimate 12 h incl reads, 3 s dwell, flyback, margin')

# Acquisition settings only; no validator, gate pacing, or heater changes.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
sr0.sensitivity(20e-3)
_fan_sens0, _fan_sens1 = sr0.sensitivity(),sr1.sensitivity()
assert np.isclose(_fan_sens0,20e-3) and np.isclose(_fan_sens1,100e-6)
mc = dict(meas_config)
mc.update({'Si (V)':_fan_Si, 'sample_temperature:':_fan_Ts, 'sr1_gain':1.0,
           'calibration':dict(FAN_CAL, source_run=5, absolute_scale='geometry prior', D_zero='working symmetry estimate'),
           'fan_n_1e12_cm2':fan_n.tolist(),'D_V_per_nm':0.0,
           'lockin_tau_s':list(_fan_taus),'lockin_slope_dB':list(_fan_slopes),
           'comments':'B_1-B_2; D~0; n -1.2..3.2e12 provisional; B 0..10 T ascending; Si0; 3s dwell; full accessible carrier signs'})
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment('plan step 4; B_1-B_2; run5 working D=0; n_A=-1.2..+3.2e12 cm^-2,111 pts; B controls 0,.7,1,1.25; inverse-B 1.5..4T 61pts then4.2..10T 30pts; Si0; sr1 100uV; dwell3s; density scale geometry-prior')
# Raw lock-in channels: gains are applied only by downstream analysis.
_fan_follow = [T_sample,T_vaporizer,k_tg.curr,k_bg.curr,sr0.X,sr0.P,sr1.X,sr1.P,magnet.field,k_tg.volt,k_bg.volt]
for parameter in _fan_follow:
    s.fp(parameter)
    s.plot('time',parameter)
# Fixed point layout: time, Bset, TGset, BGset, then _fan_follow above.
_fan_count = 0
_fan_stop_reasons = []
def fan_guard(station, data):
    global _fan_count
    values=np.asarray(data,dtype=float)
    reasons=[]
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(values)): reasons.append('nonfinite data')
    if abs(values[6])>1e-9 or abs(values[7])>1e-9: reasons.append('gate current >1nA')
    if abs(values[8])>0.90*_fan_sens0 or abs(values[10])>0.90*_fan_sens1: reasons.append('lock-in headroom <10%')
    if values[8]/mc['sr0_gain']<5e-9: reasons.append('drain current <5nA')
    if not (1.0<=values[4]<=1.5 and values[5]<1.6 and abs(values[5]-values[4])<0.6): reasons.append('temperature outside base window')
    if abs(values[12]-values[1])>0.03: reasons.append('field readback mismatch >30mT')
    if abs(values[13]-values[2])>0.01 or abs(values[14]-values[3])>0.01: reasons.append('gate readback mismatch >10mV')
    if _fan_count % 10 == 0:
        try:
            for name in ('T_sample','T_vaporizer'):
                assert_thermometry_live(name,VTI.temp_logfile_candidates[name],max_age=15,max_period=12)
        except Exception as exc: reasons.append(str(exc))
    if _fan_count < 3 or _fan_count % len(fan_n)==len(fan_n)-1:
        print(f'FAN checkpoint point {_fan_count+1}: Bset/read={values[1]:.4f}/{values[12]:.4f}T, I={values[8]/mc["sr0_gain"]*1e9:.3f}nA, X={values[10]*1e6:.3f}uV, Ts={values[4]:.3f}K')
    _fan_count += 1
    if reasons:
        _fan_stop_reasons.extend(reasons)
        print('FAN STOP / E0 required:', '; '.join(reasons))
        station.interrupt_requested=True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard,())

      f"roundtrip n,D = {calc_nD(Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])}")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (expect 10 T: the electron spot check ended there), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0 - 10.0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

B_vec = np.unique(np.round(np.arange(10.0, 0.2999, -0.02), 4))[::-1]   # 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Fixed sensitivity: 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA (R(B=0) ~ 250-300 Ohm near the CNP side; MR + SdH maxima at 10 T size the headroom).
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"sdh-spot-check hole: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 10 -> 0.3 T, 20 mT, sr1 50 uV"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'hole side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 10 -> 0.3 T uniform-B 20 mT (ride-down); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 0.3 T — no park here.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
